summary: RPCS3 Core 616 = the delivered Core 610 plus one folded delta: the Core 612 and Core 613 records unchanged and three Core 616 changes (insertions only over Core 613, build-utils/rpcs3/core616-from-613.patch): a non-forced ZCULL poll no longer waits for the GPU when the oldest part of a query spanning a command-buffer flush found no hit (REWINDBOX_ZCULL_POLL_NO_WAIT_616, with the measurement-only COREPROF ZCULLWAIT616, Assassin's Creed Build 614 logs); Black Ops II only, the vertex depth fallback compresses window Z above 1 so the draws pinned in front of the scene keep their depth order (REWINDBOX_ZCLIP_WINDOW_Z_616, RPCS3 issue #13227 capture) and the title's SPU object files are read into memory ahead of the compile threads (REWINDBOX_SPU_OBJECT_PREFETCH_616, COREPROF SPUPREFETCH616, Build 614 logs); ABI 30, the 92 exports of Core 613, the PPU/SPU codegen identities (four exact aliases) and the MoltenVK dependency of Core 610 unchanged.

route.note: The route keeps its Core 610 file names (workflow, gate, driver, recipe patch, core610-proof.json, core610-recipe.sh): the frozen recipe patch and the driver pins name the gate path, so the executed recipe stays byte-identical to the one Core 610 executed. Every per-build value is declared here.
